ITEM 1 | Two halved cylindrical pieces, bright yellow outer rim with pale cream-white center, each cut face showing a ring of kernel-like segments radiating around a pale fibrous core; surfaces appear matte and slightly moist, with a few small yellow specks on the plate near them; sitting side by side in the center-right of a large square white plate, each piece about 5 cm across and 4 cm tall, holding their shape firmly | 130

ITEM 2 | Faint yellowish smears and small specks of residue on the white plate surface near the food, suggesting a thin film of oil or juice, no pooling or sheen beyond a light trace | 3
